normalization: L2 normalized rows; cosine similarity is the dot product of normalized vectors.

term_frequency.formula: 1 + ln(tf) for terms present in a card

tokenization.normalization_notes: Whitespace is collapsed before tokenization; tokens are lowercased; IV&V/I-V-V/I/V/V normalize to ivv; technical tokens such as MBSE, EPS, SysML, CubeSat, and IVV are retained in lowercase/alphanumeric-ish form.
